references/method.md, 'Tax provision (full year)': the true-up is '[auto] to compute' but neither the method nor the upload checklist says which person owns it on a manual run, so the tax true-up was left as 'not done' rather than given an owner

journal_entries_2025-09.csv JE-0901: 4,200 = 50,400/12, while the register's active assets in Sep 2025 give 3,813.69 (FA-005 ended Jan 2025, FA-007 Aug 2025, FA-008 sold) — plausibly intended, but not in expect
